additional_info.subject: RC Troubleshooting
additional_info.body:
We performed a converter grouping and noticed that the Conv.[4] was not getting supplied any power.
The PowerON = true but DC_Output_Voltage = 0
As such, the charger does not continue with the converter grouping since the converter is PowerON but doesn't have any voltage.
Then we removed the converter from the group (TB13 → Group 3) and removed from the SCB config too
The result was successfull, we were able to get the outlets to green.
Then we swapped TB12 with TB13 to understand if there was anything wrong with the cables since visually looking, there were no problems nor any damages.
Result was the same as the first, we cannot pass Converter Grouping and have no Output Voltage on the converter with the “TB12” which is previous TB13.
We have proved that the converter is not working. We have to replace converter.
